meta.game: Trackmania, via the Openplanet Data Sender plugin
meta.status: first real drive 2026-09-18 (the maintainer's drive log (not published), Stadium car): effects checked against it and the maintainer's feel; levels still on the calibrated Forza scale
meta.grip_margin: loose surfaces only (maintainer's choice 2026-09-18): on tarmac the Stadium car held 90 m/s^2 sideways without letting go, so a load-based warning pulsed through every corner. Limits per surface come from effects.trackmania.GripMarginEffect.LOOSE (first guesses) until `python -m openshaker.tm_grip <drive> --apply` learns them into effects.grip_margin.surfaces
meta.tuning: every value is a first guess; `python -m openshaker.tm_tune <session> --apply` calibrates engine range, bumps, impacts, landings, grip limits and surface names from a recorded drive
meta.acceleration: off: 30-90 m/s^2 of cornering load kept the g-force rumble near full all the time (maintainer turned it off)
meta.wheel_slip: softer (gain 0.3 -> 0.2) and lower (42 -> 32 Hz tone, 45 -> 35 Hz noise); spin_full 2.5 -> 4 softens moderate wheelspin, but a standing burnout is 100 % spin and still reads full. The source grades slides by sideways speed and reports no spin or slide from wheels in the air or settling after a landing
meta.disabled: abs, road and shift_indicator have no Trackmania data (surface replaces road); acceleration by choice
